_readme: The log envelope, pinned. This file is IDENTICAL in project-sysstra's
sysstra-logging and project-trigerr's trigerr — both push into one Loki, so a
query written against one has to work against the other. test_schema_parity.py
in each repo asserts its own formatter reproduces this exactly, so a drift in
either project fails that project's tests instead of silently splitting the
schema. Changing the envelope means editing this file in BOTH repos and
identity: emitted on every line, in this order, blank when unknown.
domain: reserved names, emitted ONLY where the concept exists. Padding these
would make 'this repo has no such concept' indistinguishable from 'this line
intrinsic: computed from the record; a call site cannot displace them.
